content:
Sofia (Eng): Hey team  planning to share parental leave with my partner starting mid-May. We'll split the 12 weeks as 6 weeks each back-to-back. Quick q: what's the process to register a shared/split leave so payroll top-up, benefits, and childcare subsidy align? Also need to coordinate interview coverage and a short handoff.

People Ops Bot: Start the shared leave flow at https://hr.redwood.com/leave and choose 'Shared/Partner Leave'. Upload partner declaration and birth/adoption docs. See guide: https://hr.redwood.com/shared-leave-guide.

Sofia (Eng): Thanks. Do I need partner's employer sign-off or just a signed declaration?

Benefits: A signed partner declaration is fine for Redwood's records. If your partner's employer offers a top-up, that doesn't affect ours, but we do ask for the partner's leave dates on the form so benefits coverage windows are correct.

Payroll: For the alternation you described (6 weeks each), upload docs at least 10 business days before your first leave day so Redwood top-up applies on the first affected pay run. Note: if the pay period crosses the handoff between you and your partner, payroll may need the partner's declaration + SSN/Tax ID to properly apply any tax withholding rules. Please cc payroll@redwood.com with partner docs if that is the case.

Sofia (Eng): Understood. Our handoff date might fall mid-payroll. We'll upload partner docs and cc payroll. Also, does the childcare subsidy follow the primary caregiver or can we split subsidy claims?

Childcare Admin: Childcare subsidy can be split between parents if both are Redwood employees and both submit receipts. We need claims and receipts uploaded within 30 days of expense. If subsidy overlaps two people's leave periods, submit per-person claim with notes indicating split percentage. Email childcare@redwood.com for a merged claim template.

Ben (Manager): I can cover the recurring interview screens and on-call during Sofia's weeks. Sofia, drop a short 1-paragraph runbook and list any candidates in flight. I'll also block shadowing sessions before you go.

Sofia (Eng): Will add a 1-paragraph runbook and candidate list today. One more operational question: do I set limited availability or full OOO for the 6 weeks? We might do one short async check-in during partner's weeks.

People Ops Bot: For split/shared leave, set availability to 'Full OOO' during your active leave weeks. If you want a single async check-in during the partner's leave, document that on the form under 'Limited contact while away' and get manager sign-off.

Benefits: Note on benefits: continuous medical coverage continues during paid parental leave. If you or your partner plan to change address or bank details during the shared period, upload updates before the payroll cutoff to avoid payment/delivery issues for subsidy and benefits mailings.

Payroll: Also flag: if your partner is a non-US employee or uses a foreign tax ID, processing may require a separate payroll run for the partner-pay period. That's why we request partner tax details if the handoff period spans pay runs.

Sofia (Eng): Good to know. For the childcare subsidy receipts  do they need to be itemized invoices from the provider?

Childcare Admin: Yes, itemized invoices with provider name, dates of service, and amounts are required. If splitting claims, each Redwood employee must upload their share and include the partner's name and employee ID in the claim notes.

Ben (Manager): On the hiring/frontline ops: I'm happy to take screens Tue mornings and own offer approvals while you're out. Sofia, please add candidate red-flags next to names.

Sofia (Eng): Will do. Quick checklist I'm posting here so others can comment:

```
- Submit shared leave form: https://hr.redwood.com/leave (choose Shared/Partner)
- Upload: birth/adoption docs, partner declaration, partner tax ID if handoff spans pay runs
- Payroll docs in >=10 business days before first leave day for top-up
- Set availability: Full OOO during active leave; note any allowed async check-ins
- Childcare subsidy: itemized invoices, upload within 30 days; split claims allowed
- Manager (Ben) to cover interviews/on-call; schedule 1-hour shadow sessions
- Update direct deposit if changing accounts before leave
```

Benefits: If you want assistance pre-submitting subsidy claims or benefits changes while on leave, reply here and we'll assist with uploads.

Sofia (Eng): Thanks everyone  I'll submit the form and post the runbook link here once uploaded. Appreciate the help :heart:
